source: Catálogo PostgreSQL inmobiliaria leído mediante SELECT; sólo las 17 tablas de Tarea 2.

constraints.name: cities_province_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (province_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.provinces(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: consultations_property_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (property_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.properties(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: consultations_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: favorites_property_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (property_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: favorites_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: notifications_consultation_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (consultation_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.consultations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: notifications_property_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (property_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.properties(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: notifications_publisher_application_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (publisher_application_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.publisher_applications(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: notifications_read_date
constraints.definition: CHECK (read_at IS NULL OR read_at >= created_at)

constraints.name: notifications_reference_type
constraints.definition: CHECK (type = 'new_consultation'::text AND consultation_id IS NOT NULL AND publisher_application_id IS NULL AND search_alert_id IS NULL AND property_id IS NULL OR (type = ANY (ARRAY['publisher_approved'::text, 'publisher_rejected'::text])) AND publisher_application_id IS NOT NULL AND consultation_id IS NULL AND search_alert_id IS NULL AND property_id IS NULL OR type = 'new_property_match'::text AND search_alert_id IS NOT NULL AND property_id IS NOT NULL AND consultation_id IS NULL AND publisher_application_id IS NULL)

constraints.name: notifications_search_alert_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (search_alert_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.search_alerts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: notifications_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: properties_city_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (city_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.cities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: properties_publisher_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (publisher_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.publisher_profiles(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: property_amenities_amenity_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (amenity_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.amenities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: property_amenities_property_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (property_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: property_change_history_changed_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (changed_by) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: property_change_history_property_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (property_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.properties(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: property_images_property_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (property_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: property_services_property_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (property_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.properties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: property_services_service_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.services(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: property_views_property_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (property_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.properties(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: publisher_application_agency_name
constraints.definition: CHECK (publisher_type = 'individual'::text AND agency_name IS NULL OR publisher_type = 'agency'::text AND agency_name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(agency_name) <> ''::text)

constraints.name: publisher_application_resolution
constraints.definition: CHECK (status = 'pending'::text AND reviewed_at IS NULL AND reviewed_by IS NULL AND rejection_reason IS NULL OR status = 'approved'::text AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_by IS NOT NULL AND rejection_reason IS NULL OR status = 'rejected'::text AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_by IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: publisher_application_reviewer
constraints.definition: CHECK (reviewed_by IS NULL OR reviewed_by <> user_id)

constraints.name: publisher_applications_reviewed_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (reviewed_by) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: publisher_applications_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: publisher_profile_agency_name
constraints.definition: CHECK (publisher_type = 'individual'::text AND agency_name IS NULL OR publisher_type = 'agency'::text AND agency_name IS NOT NULL AND btrim(agency_name) <> ''::text)

constraints.name: publisher_profiles_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: search_alert_has_filter
constraints.definition: CHECK (operation_type IS NOT NULL OR property_type IS NOT NULL OR province_id IS NOT NULL OR city_id IS NOT NULL OR currency IS NOT NULL OR min_price IS NOT NULL OR max_price IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: search_alert_location
constraints.definition: CHECK (province_id IS NULL OR city_id IS NULL)

constraints.name: search_alert_price_currency
constraints.definition: CHECK (min_price IS NULL AND max_price IS NULL OR currency IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: search_alert_price_range
constraints.definition: CHECK (min_price IS NULL OR max_price IS NULL OR min_price <= max_price)

constraints.name: search_alerts_city_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (city_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.cities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: search_alerts_currency_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (currency IS NULL OR (currency::text = ANY (ARRAY['ARS'::character varying, 'USD'::character varying]::text[])))

constraints.name: search_alerts_province_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (province_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.provinces(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: search_alerts_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES inmobiliaria.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: users_publisher_phone
constraints.definition: CHECK (role <> 'publisher'::text OR phone IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: consultations_property_date
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX consultations_property_date ON inmobiliaria.consultations USING btree (property_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: consultations_user_date
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX consultations_user_date ON inmobiliaria.consultations USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC) WHERE (user_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: favorites_property
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX favorites_property ON inmobiliaria.favorites USING btree (property_id)

indexes.name: notifications_alert_property_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX notifications_alert_property_unique ON inmobiliaria.notifications USING btree (search_alert_id, property_id) WHERE (type = 'new_property_match'::text)

indexes.name: notifications_application
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX notifications_application ON inmobiliaria.notifications USING btree (publisher_application_id) WHERE (publisher_application_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: notifications_consultation
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX notifications_consultation ON inmobiliaria.notifications USING btree (consultation_id) WHERE (consultation_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: notifications_search_alert
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX notifications_search_alert ON inmobiliaria.notifications USING btree (search_alert_id) WHERE (search_alert_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: notifications_unread_user
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX notifications_unread_user ON inmobiliaria.notifications USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC) WHERE (read_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: notifications_user_date
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX notifications_user_date ON inmobiliaria.notifications USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: properties_active_operation
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX properties_active_operation ON inmobiliaria.properties USING btree (operation_type) WHERE (publication_status = 'active'::text)

indexes.name: properties_active_price
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX properties_active_price ON inmobiliaria.properties USING btree (currency, price) WHERE (publication_status = 'active'::text)

indexes.name: properties_active_type
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX properties_active_type ON inmobiliaria.properties USING btree (property_type) WHERE (publication_status = 'active'::text)

indexes.name: properties_city_status
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX properties_city_status ON inmobiliaria.properties USING btree (city_id, publication_status)

indexes.name: properties_publisher_status
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX properties_publisher_status ON inmobiliaria.properties USING btree (publisher_id, publication_status)

indexes.name: property_amenities_amenity
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX property_amenities_amenity ON inmobiliaria.property_amenities USING btree (amenity_id)

indexes.name: property_change_history_property_date
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX property_change_history_property_date ON inmobiliaria.property_change_history USING btree (property_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: property_services_service
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX property_services_service ON inmobiliaria.property_services USING btree (service_id)

indexes.name: property_views_property_date
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX property_views_property_date ON inmobiliaria.property_views USING btree (property_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: publisher_applications_status_date
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX publisher_applications_status_date ON inmobiliaria.publisher_applications USING btree (status, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: publisher_applications_tax_id_open_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publisher_applications_tax_id_open_unique ON inmobiliaria.publisher_applications USING btree (tax_id) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'approved'::text]))

indexes.name: publisher_applications_user_date
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX publisher_applications_user_date ON inmobiliaria.publisher_applications USING btree (user_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: publisher_applications_user_open_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publisher_applications_user_open_unique ON inmobiliaria.publisher_applications USING btree (user_id) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'approved'::text]))

indexes.name: search_alerts_active_city
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX search_alerts_active_city ON inmobiliaria.search_alerts USING btree (city_id) WHERE ((is_active = true) AND (city_id IS NOT NULL))

indexes.name: search_alerts_active_province
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX search_alerts_active_province ON inmobiliaria.search_alerts USING btree (province_id) WHERE ((is_active = true) AND (province_id IS NOT NULL))

indexes.name: search_alerts_user_active
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX search_alerts_user_active ON inmobiliaria.search_alerts USING btree (user_id, is_active)

indexes.name: users_email_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_email_unique ON inmobiliaria.users USING btree (lower(email))
